site.name: AI helpers for small businesses
hub.lead: Pick the job that takes too much of your time. Each helper works on your phone, in the AI you already use, in your language.
hub.pick: What do you want help with?
lang.label: Language
step.answer.note: Every question is optional. Leave it empty or type "pass". You can tap the mic on your keyboard and speak.
keepout.title: Never type these
keepout.body: Customers' names or phone numbers, ID numbers (Aadhaar, PAN, passport), bank, UPI or card details, passwords or OTPs, health details, sales or money figures (your public prices are fine).
helper.what: These are instructions for the AI. You don't need to read them all.
copy.fail: Copy didn't work here. Press and hold the text, then choose Copy.
use.title: How to use it
use.2: Open Claude, or the AI you already use, and start a new chat.
use.3: Paste the helper and send it.
use.4: Then paste one customer message at a time (copying several adds names or numbers), or describe today's job. Delete names and numbers first.
save.title: Keep it for next time
save.body: Send the helper to yourself in WhatsApp ("Message yourself"). It keeps working after free credits end. Free AI plans limit messages per day; if one stops, paste the same helper into another AI chat.
save.project: On a paid Claude plan, make a Project and paste the helper as its instructions. Then every chat in that Project already knows your business.
try.title: Try it here
try.note: This runs on your own Claude account. This page saves nothing.
laptop.title: On a laptop? Install the full version
laptop.body: The full version has more steps, examples and safety rules. Download each Skill below. Then in Claude open Settings, then Capabilities, then Skills, and upload the file. You need a paid plan with code execution turned on (as of October 2026).
laptop.code: In Claude Code or Cowork, add this collection once, then install this helper:
draft.note: This translation is a draft. Please check it with someone who reads this language well.
footer: Free to use and adapt (CC0). It drafts; you check and send everything yourself.
err.declined: To try it here, allow Claude for this page. Or copy the helper and use it in Claude.
err.busy: Too many tries at once. Wait a minute, then try again.
err.generic: That didn't work. Copy the helper and use it in Claude instead.
empty.answers: You left everything empty. That's fine: the helper will ask you.
pkg.start-here.title: Start here
pkg.start-here.short: Not sure yet? Find one job AI can help with this week.
pkg.start-here.problem: You know your week is too full, but you're not sure which job to hand to AI first.
pkg.start-here.outcome: One clear job, what to try first, and which helper to open next.
pkg.start-here.q.business: What kind of business is it?
pkg.start-here.q.business.hint: For example: homestay in North Goa, café, cleaning service.
pkg.start-here.q.week: Which part of your week takes the most time?
pkg.start-here.q.week.hint: For example: replying to customers, posts, bookings, staff, paperwork.
pkg.start-here.try.label: Tell it about your week
pkg.start-here.try.placeholder: I run a small café. Mornings go on WhatsApp orders and I never have time for posts.
pkg.customer-replies.title: Reply to customer messages
pkg.customer-replies.short: AI drafts the routine replies in your tone for you to check and send. You write only the ones that need you.
pkg.customer-replies.problem: Dozens of WhatsApp messages a day. Most ask the same things, and replying to each one takes hours.
pkg.customer-replies.outcome: Routine replies drafted in your tone, a short list of messages that really need you, and quick replies you can send in two taps.
pkg.customer-replies.q.business: What kind of business is it, and where?
pkg.customer-replies.q.business.hint: For example: cleaning service in North Goa.
pkg.customer-replies.q.facts: What do customers ask most, and what are your answers?
pkg.customer-replies.q.facts.hint: Hours, services, areas you cover, how prices work, how to book. Prices are fine. No customer names or numbers.
pkg.customer-replies.q.tone: How do you like to sound?
pkg.customer-replies.q.tone.hint: For example: warm and short, a little Hinglish, always say thank you.
pkg.customer-replies.q.needs_me: Which messages must always come to you?
pkg.customer-replies.q.needs_me.hint: For example: complaints, discounts, site visits, big orders.
pkg.customer-replies.try.label: Paste one or two customer messages
pkg.customer-replies.try.placeholder: Customer 1: hi what is the rate for deep cleaning a 2bhk and are you free sunday?
pkg.booking-reminders.title: Bookings and reminders
pkg.booking-reminders.short: Confirmation and reminder messages that tell customers exactly what to do.
pkg.booking-reminders.problem: Customers book, then forget what to bring or don't turn up. Confirming and reminding each one by hand takes time.
pkg.booking-reminders.outcome: A full set of booking messages (confirm, remind, reschedule, no-show, thank you). The full version adds a booking sheet and a daily routine.
pkg.booking-reminders.q.business: What do people book with you?
pkg.booking-reminders.q.business.hint: For example: water testing, deep cleaning visits, yoga classes.
pkg.booking-reminders.q.where: Do customers come to you, or do you go to them?
pkg.booking-reminders.q.where.hint: And where: your address stays out of the chat; just say "our lab" or "their home".
pkg.booking-reminders.q.prep: What must the customer do or bring beforehand?
pkg.booking-reminders.q.prep.hint: Your own instructions only. For example: a clean bottle, how much, by what time.
pkg.booking-reminders.q.timing.hint: For example: the evening before and 2 hours before.
pkg.booking-reminders.try.label: Describe one booking
pkg.booking-reminders.try.placeholder: water test booking, Thursday October 22, 10 am at our lab.
pkg.follow-ups.title: Follow-ups that get replies
pkg.follow-ups.short: A polite 3-step follow-up, a daily "who to message today" list, and an end-of-day report.
pkg.follow-ups.problem: You reach out to everyone, but there's no time to follow up on each call or unanswered message.
pkg.follow-ups.outcome: A ready follow-up sequence, a tracker that shows who is due today, and a short daily report from your notes.
pkg.follow-ups.q.who: Who do you follow up with?
pkg.follow-ups.q.who.hint: For example: past supporters, members, customers who asked for a quote.
pkg.follow-ups.q.ask: What does your first message ask for?
pkg.follow-ups.q.ask.hint: For example: join our December drive, renew membership, book a visit.
pkg.follow-ups.q.sign: How do you sign your messages?
pkg.follow-ups.q.sign.hint: For example: your first name and group name.
pkg.follow-ups.try.label: Ask for your sequence
pkg.find-clients.title: Find new clients
pkg.find-clients.short: Turn your best customers into a clear picture of who to look for, where, and what to say.
pkg.find-clients.problem: You need a steady list of new clients, but you're not sure who to look for or how to reach out.
pkg.find-clients.outcome: Customer types, search phrases you can use yourself, local partners who could refer you, and first messages in your voice.
pkg.find-clients.q.offer: What do you sell, and to whom?
pkg.find-clients.q.offer.hint: For example: social media management for cafés and homestays.
pkg.find-clients.q.best: Describe your 3 best customers (types, not names)
pkg.find-clients.q.best.hint: For example: a 20-room resort, a new café, a yoga school.
pkg.find-clients.q.area.hint: For example: North Goa, all of Goa, online across India.
pkg.find-clients.q.channel: How would you like to reach out?
pkg.find-clients.q.channel.hint: Email, contact form, LinkedIn, Instagram or in person (WhatsApp once they reply).
pkg.find-clients.try.label: Start with step 1
pkg.one-page-shop.title: Your shop on one page
pkg.one-page-shop.short: One link for everything you offer, with a clear button for each: buy, book or ask.
pkg.one-page-shop.problem: People find you on Instagram, but there's no single place to see everything you offer and buy, book or ask in one tap.
pkg.one-page-shop.outcome: An offer map and checklist, words for a one-page shop with one button per offer, a ready page file, and replies for each path. The full version adds a weekly check.
pkg.one-page-shop.q.offers: What do you offer? List each one.
pkg.one-page-shop.q.offers.hint: For example: original paintings, prints, weekend workshops, custom orders.
pkg.one-page-shop.q.who: Who buys or books, and where do they find you now?
pkg.one-page-shop.q.who.hint: For example: tourists and locals, mostly through Instagram and friends.
pkg.one-page-shop.q.action: What should people do for each offer?
pkg.one-page-shop.q.action.hint: For example: buy prints, book a workshop, ask about a custom piece.
pkg.one-page-shop.q.tools: What do you already use to sell or take bookings?
pkg.one-page-shop.q.tools.hint: For example: a shop app, a payment link, a booking form, WhatsApp. No links or account details.
pkg.one-page-shop.try.label: Start with your offer map
pkg.get-found-on-google.title: Get found on Google
pkg.get-found-on-google.short: A complete Google profile, the right words, and steps to earn genuine reviews.
pkg.get-found-on-google.problem: When people search for what you sell in your area, your business doesn't show up.
pkg.get-found-on-google.outcome: A checklist for your Google Business Profile, a description and services list in Google's limits, weekly posts, a review request message and a list of search words.
pkg.get-found-on-google.q.business: What kind of business is it?
pkg.get-found-on-google.q.business.hint: For example: equipment rental for builders and events.
pkg.get-found-on-google.q.services: Your main services or products (up to 5)
pkg.get-found-on-google.q.services.hint: For example: scaffolding, generators, concrete mixers.
pkg.get-found-on-google.q.towns: Which towns or areas do you serve?
pkg.get-found-on-google.q.towns.hint: For example: Mapusa, Panjim, Margao, all of North Goa.
pkg.get-found-on-google.q.status: Do you have a Google Business Profile?
pkg.get-found-on-google.q.status.hint: Yes and verified, yes but not verified, no, or not sure.
pkg.get-found-on-google.q.different: What makes you different? (only what you can show)
pkg.get-found-on-google.q.different.hint: For example: same-day delivery, operator included, 15 years in business.
pkg.get-found-on-google.try.label: Start with part 1
pkg.staff-checklists.title: Staff checklists
pkg.staff-checklists.short: Clear opening, closing and daily checklists for each role, so work runs without you.
pkg.staff-checklists.problem: Each person does the job differently, and things slip when you're not there.
pkg.staff-checklists.outcome: One checklist per role and shift, a short version for the wall, and a weekly 15-minute check (full version).
pkg.staff-checklists.q.business: What kind of business is it?
pkg.staff-checklists.q.business.hint: For example: café with a bakery and a bar.
pkg.staff-checklists.q.roles.hint: For example: kitchen, bakery, bar, cash counter.
pkg.staff-checklists.q.slips: What goes wrong when you're away?
pkg.staff-checklists.q.slips.hint: For example: fridge not checked, counter not closed properly, stock not noted.
pkg.staff-checklists.q.hours.hint: For example: open 8 am, close 10 pm.
pkg.staff-checklists.try.label: Name a role and a shift
pkg.hire-and-onboard.title: Hire and welcome staff
pkg.hire-and-onboard.short: Job posts that bring the right people, fewer drop-offs, and a calm first week.
pkg.hire-and-onboard.problem: You need skilled people to join, but they don't reach out, or they stop halfway through signing up.
pkg.hire-and-onboard.outcome: Where people drop off and what to fix first, job posts and outreach messages, applicant replies, and a first-week checklist.
pkg.hire-and-onboard.q.roles: Which roles do you hire for?
pkg.hire-and-onboard.q.today: How do people find you and join today?
pkg.hire-and-onboard.q.today.hint: For example: we call them, they register on our app, then we verify documents.
pkg.hire-and-onboard.q.dropoff: Where do people drop off? (numbers only, no names)
pkg.hire-and-onboard.q.dropoff.hint: For example: 40 contacted, 12 replied, 3 finished signing up.
pkg.hire-and-onboard.q.week1: What does a new person need in the first week?
pkg.hire-and-onboard.q.week1.hint: For example: who to call, first visits with a senior, how shifts work.
pkg.hire-and-onboard.try.label: Start with your hiring steps
pkg.social-posts.title: Posts that bring customers
pkg.social-posts.short: A week of posts and captions in your voice, with photo ideas you can shoot yourself.
pkg.social-posts.problem: No time to post, and the views you get don't turn into customers.
pkg.social-posts.outcome: A plan for this week's posts with captions and photo ideas, each with one clear next step, plus replies for comments and messages. The full version adds a simple plan for turning followers into customers and launching a workshop.
pkg.social-posts.q.business: What kind of business is it, and where?
pkg.social-posts.q.special.hint: Only true things: your best item, your story, your view.
pkg.social-posts.q.week.hint: For example: new menu item, festival opening hours, a workshop.
pkg.social-posts.try.label: Ask for this week's plan
